* Meta Platforms, Inc. (META) - Strong digital transformation story with a solid balance sheet. Concerns around increased competition in the digital advertising space. ESG risk: Medium, primarily related to data privacy and cybersecurity.
 + Proposed allocation: 8% (well within the 10% limit)
* Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) - Industry leader in the search and online advertising space, with a strong cash-generating machine. Concerns around regulatory scrutiny and increased competition from emerging technologies. ESG risk: Medium, primarily related to data privacy and potential biased search results.
 + Proposed allocation: 7% (well within the 10% limit)

ESG risk: Low, primarily related to its strong cybersecurity measures and commitment to diversity and inclusion.

ESG screen flags have been reviewed, and no significant concerns were found for these positions.
